faqData.question: When's the big day?
faqData.answer: Mark your calendars for March 20, 2026 at Watercraft Venture Corporation —come early, happy, and ready to celebrate!

faqData.question: Can I bring a plus one?
faqData.answer: We're keeping things cozy and intimate, so plus ones are not accepted.

faqData.question: Kids or no kids?
faqData.answer: Yes, kids are welcome! We'd love to celebrate with the whole family.

faqData.question: Food situation?
faqData.answer: Come hungry. There will be delicious food, drinks, and plenty of reasons to dance.

faqData.question: Photos—yes or no?
faqData.answer: During the ceremony, we ask for phones down and hearts open. After that—snap away! And please don't forget to share your snaps in our shared drive.

faqData.question: Gifts?
faqData.answer: No pressure at all—your love and laughter are more than enough. But if you desire to give nonetheless, a MONETARY GIFT is one we suggest.
